text: In 17th century South Malabar, the folk singer Thevan flees a yakshi in the forest and stumbles on a ramshackle manor, where the aged lord Kodumon Potti asks him to sing and then [insists he stay for the rest of his life|wants|keeping people forever]. The cook warns him not to ask questions, and tells of a goblin, a chathan, [chained in the attic by a sorcerer|images|ropes, cages and executions]. Days pass, Thevan forgets his own name, and each time he reaches the gateway, [a spell sickens him and turns him back|rules|trapped with no way out].
